result.stdout:
defuscator — static JavaScript deobfuscation and risk triage

Usage:
  defuscator <file.js> [--json] [--decode-only]
  cat file.js | defuscator [--json] [--decode-only]

Options:
  --json          Emit the full analysis as JSON (for pipelines).
  --sarif         Emit SARIF 2.1.0 (GitHub code scanning / SOC pipelines).
  --sourcemap     Recover original sources from an inline source map.
  --decode-only   Print only the decoded/beautified output.
  --obfuscate     Obfuscate the input instead of analyzing it (static, no eval).
  -h, --help      Show this help.

Exit code: 0 = low/none, 1 = medium risk, 2 = high risk (>=68). Code is never executed.
